summary.title: Langfuse Trace not found - Long-term fix implementation
summary.description: Implemented TDD solution for Issue #194 to fix Langfuse trace_id not being saved to conversation metadata

tasks_completed.description: Create ConversationService DI function in dependencies.py
Refactor chat_endpoints.py - use DI, replace save_message() with save_with_metadata()
Frontend improvements - demo data detection and Langfuse link visibility

coverage.estimate: Target coverage maintained (90%+ for modified files)

modified_files: expertAgent/app/services/conversation/llm_service.py - Return trace_id from stream and non-streaming functions
expertAgent/app/api/v1/chat_endpoints.py - Added _save_conversation_with_metadata() helper, capture trace_id from stream
expertAgent/tests/unit/test_llm_service_langfuse.py - Added trace_id return tests, fixed return signature tests
myAgentDesk/src/routes/mlops/diagnostics/+page.svelte - Added isUsingDemoData flag, isValidLangfuseUrl() function, demo warning banner, conditional Langfuse link visibility

key_improvements: trace_id is now extracted from Langfuse CallbackHandler after LLM invocation

Conversation is saved with full metadata including trace_id to Valkey
Frontend detects demo data and shows warning banner
Langfuse link is hidden when URL contains /trace/demo
